summary: pi session semantics: without --session/ZENPI_SESSION/-s each launch creates a fresh journal ~/.zenpi/sessions/<ms>-<pid>.jsonl (flat, so the catalog and -s find it); -c/--continue reopens the newest journal whose header cwd equals the current cwd (header line only); --no-session uses a private temp dir removed on exit. The shared global ~/.zenpi/session.jsonl is no longer the default.
commands_run: cargo test --locked --all-features --no-fail-fast --test headless_protocol --test headless_lifecycle --test headless_project_workspace --test session_new --test session_recovery --test session_cli --test stage1_host --test tui_task --test session_torn_tail --test stage1_session_tree --test resume_compact_owner

validation_result.distinct_cwds: two launches in two cwds -> two journals; no global session.jsonl
validation_result.continue: -c in repo-a appends to repo-a only, journal count unchanged
validation_result.parallel_default: 24 concurrent default launches, zero session_locked, 24 journals

notes: Default opens still use SessionStore::open rather than open_in_workspace (the new journal is created for the current cwd, so the workspace check adds little); request ids are idempotency keys in a resumed session, so the test uses a fresh id per run.
